title: Next.co.uk Product Scraper
description: Extract products from Next using either a Next URL or a keyword. Supports pagination, location/territory, and proxy configuration.

url.title: URL
url.description: Any supported Next page URL, for example https://www.next.co.uk/search?w=shirt or category/shop URLs.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Keyword search term. Used when URL is not provided.

location.title: Location / Territory
location.description: Two-letter territory code (for example GB, OM, PL, AE).

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to extract.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of API pages to request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for more reliable data extraction.
